critical.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error. Backend log: AttributeError: 'bytearray' object has no attribute 'encode'. Line 1141 server.py: `pdf.output(dest="S")` in current fpdf2 version returns `bytearray`. The isinstance(...,bytes) guard is False (bytearray != bytes), so the else branch calls `.encode('latin-1')` on the bytearray and crashes. Fix: `out = pdf.output(dest='S'); buf = io.BytesIO(bytes(out) if isinstance(out, (bytes, bytearray)) else out.encode('latin-1'))`. Breaks the new ticket-pdf-{id} download button on /tickets page.

rca of the issue: PDF endpoint 500: server.py line 1141 does `io.BytesIO(pdf.output(dest='S') if isinstance(pdf.output(dest='S'), bytes) else pdf.output(dest='S').encode('latin-1'))`. fpdf2>=2.7 returns `bytearray`, so isinstance check is False; then `.encode('latin-1')` is called on the bytearray which has no encode method. Reproduce: GET https://analyze-improve-6.preview.emergentagent.com/api/tickets/<any-existing-ticket-id>/pdf?token=<jwt> → 500. Mitigation: `out = pdf.output(dest='S'); raw = bytes(out) if isinstance(out, (bytes, bytearray)) else out.encode('latin-1'); buf = io.BytesIO(raw)`. After fix, re-run `pytest backend/tests/test_phase4_stations_ics_pkpass.py::TestTicketExports::test_pdf_with_query_token -v`.
